head: working-tree
subject: HTTP/3 capsule caller-buffer writer computes varint lengths once
change: capsule.writeInto now computes the capsule-type and value-length varint sizes once, checks the total header and payload bounds with checked arithmetic, and writes both varints through a new bounds-checked quic.varint.encodeIntoWithLen. Previously encodedLen computed both lengths, then each quic.varint.encodeInto recomputed its own length, for four length classifications per capsule. The payload copy and overlap-safe copyForwards behavior are unchanged.

benchmark.note: The host was loaded during this batch, so absolute times are higher than the quiet-host 39 ns baseline; only the interleaved ratio is claimed.

notes: The new public varint helper keeps the existing unchecked internal writer private and adds an explicit output-bound check, so callers cannot overrun a short buffer. The capsule parser path is unchanged at 2 ns/op. A capsule with an empty value still writes the type and zero length varints and returns the exact consumed slice.
